messages:
Nina Sol: Scheduling enable of atlas-3 in the model catalog for tonight's 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Staged pin: canary -> regional -> global. Posting quick ops checklist here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: model=atlas-3, mode=staged, canary_regions=[ap-southeast-1], rollout_steps=3, ticket=ENG-6240. Canary traffic=1%.

Arjun Rao: Fallback ordering? I want deterministic fallback to atlas-2 (full FP) before any quant variants. No auto-quant.

Taylor Nguyen: Fallback planned: 1) atlas-2 (pinned), 2) atlas-2-compat, 3) atlas-small. We will set atlas-2 pin priority high during rollout.

Maria Ortiz: Ops guardrails: abort+rollback if combined error-rate > 4% sustained 4m in canary. If p95 jumps > 180ms for 8m, pause and investigate.

Nina Sol: Observability checklist: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, kv-cache-hit, batch-size histo, cost-per-token. Ensure debug kv-cache misses exported.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK: artifacts checksum match, tokenizer parity OK, infra capacity=6 GPUs reserved in ap-southeast-1.

Nina Sol: Smoke test (staging):
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"atlas-3","input":"Describe Redwood's batching strategy."}'
```
Expect 200, coherent output, streaming start <250ms.

deploy-bot: Starting step 1: enabling canary in ap-southeast-1 at 3012345700.

Taylor Nguyen: Canary looks healthy first 7m. p95 -10ms vs baseline. kv-hit 80%, median batch 7.

Arjun Rao: Noted slight increase in tail at 9m, p95 +140ms but still under threshold. Holding progression for 5m.

Maria Ortiz: After quick reprovision of one worker, p95 back to baseline. Recommend proceed to regional ramp to 12%.

Nina Sol: Proceeding. deploy-bot start step 2. Reminder: pin atlas-2 as fallback.

deploy-bot: Step 2 started: regional ramp to 12% at 3012345740.

Nina Sol: I'll post final status when global enable completes or if rollback occurs. Keep updates in this thread only.

Taylor Nguyen: All good from infra side. :thumbsup:

Arjun Rao: Thanks team. Good coordination.

Nina Sol: Closing for now. Will update ENG-6240 with metrics snapshot after full rollout.
